To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the laser pulse shape should be optimized with the square laser pulses of 10 to 20 ps to obtain the minimum beam emittances.
the square laser pulse with 20 ps length and 0.8 mm x 1.00 mm laser profile was used and the minimum beam emittances with 0.4-nC and 1.0-nC beam charge were measured to be 3.0 and 2.3 mm.mrad.
the laser pulse length dependence of beam emittance was investigated by using 10 and 2.0-ps laser pulse with 0.4 and 1.0-nC beam charge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the laser pulse length and laser profile dependence on beam emittance.
the effect of the square laser pulse shape to beam emittance.
optimization of the laser pulse and its effect on the beam emittance in photo-cathode RFGun.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the beam emittance is mainly determined by the beam energy spread, which can be reduced by optimizing the laser pulse shape.
the beam emittance could not be significantly minimized with the square pulse length of 10-20 ps.
the laser pulse length of 10-20 ps and laser spot size of 1.5-2.0 mm would be the optimum condition to minimize the beam size and emittance for photo-cathode RFGun.

the laser pulse length dependence on beam emittance was investigated with the square laser shape.
